svg.title: AI Automation for Email Campaigns
svg.desc: Six-stage segment branch-and-merge workflow for email campaigns: a contact list arrives from HubSpot via webhook, Claude groups contacts by behaviour into three parallel audience lanes (new leads, active customers, dormant), each lane drafts its own subject line, the three versions merge into Mailchimp or Brevo, a human approves copy, audience and links, and the campaign queues for scheduled send.
svg.text: HubSpot list → 3 segment lanes → Mailchimp / Brevo
